articles.summary: MOLINE, Ill., Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - QCR Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: QCRH) (the “Company”) today announced that its subsidiary, Cedar Rapids Bank Trust Company, has entered into a definitive agreement with BankIowa, based in Cedar Rapids, Iowa, to sell its Community Bank Trust division, which consists of three branch locations serving the Waterloo-Cedar Falls metropolitan area. The transaction includes two branches located in Waterloo, Iowa, and one branch located in Cedar Falls, Iowa. The sale includes certain deposits and loans associated with the three branches, totaling approximately $140 million and $29 million, respectively, as of September 30, 2026. articles.title: QCR Holdings, Inc. Announces Agreement to Sell Three Branches to BankIowa
